lines.en: label osakodojo1:
scene osakokicksyourass1
So, it appears that today is the day I die.
lines.zh: 这么说,看来今天就是我死期的日子。

lines.en: I knew that visiting Osako at the dojo would be a bad idea after her parting words to me the night of her anniversary were that she was going to activate one of my apparently fatal pressure points.
lines.zh: 在她纪念日的那个晚上,临别赠言是「要去启动我身上某个显然致命的要害」之后,我就知道去道场找 Osako 不是个好主意。

lines.en: But, of course, I’ve always been bad when it comes to warnings.
lines.zh: 但当然了,一涉及警告,我向来不长记性。

lines.en: And even worse when it comes to staying away from cute girls.
lines.zh: 而一涉及远离可爱的女孩,就更没救了。

lines.en: And now, apparently girls who don’t even like men to begin with.
lines.zh: 如今,显然还加上了那些压根不喜欢男人的女孩。

lines.en: So yeah, no idea how I wound up in this mess if not for taking too many directions from my penis.
lines.zh: 所以是啊,要不是听从 penis 的指挥太多,我真不知道自己是怎么卷进这摊烂事的。

lines.en: : I’ll give you one last chance to step down, Osako.
lines.zh: : 我给你最后一次退场的机会,Osako。

lines.en: : I am bigger than you. That must be good for something.
lines.zh: : 我块头比你大。这总该有点用处。

lines.en: scene osakokicksyourass2
: Is this why you never want to actually practice? Because you’re scared?
lines.zh: : 这就是你从来不想真正练习的原因?因为你怕?

lines.en: : Or are you just feeling a little vulnerable because Ayane isn’t here to protect you today?
lines.zh: : 还是因为今天没有 Ayane 保护你,你感觉有点脆弱?

lines.en: scene osakokicksyourass1
: I don’t need Ayane’s protection. I’m just saying that any rational person would look at this matchup and assume that I am going to win.
lines.zh: : 我不需要 Ayane 的保护。我只是说,任何理性的人看到这场对阵,都会认定我会赢。

lines.en: scene osakokicksyourass2
: I’ll admit that you’re in surprisingly good shape for someone who despises any amount of physical activity.
lines.zh: : 我承认,对一个鄙视一切体力活动的人来说,你的身材好得出奇。

lines.en: : That’s not true. I love-
lines.zh: : 才不是。我爱——

lines.en: : Don’t say it.
lines.zh: : 别说出来。

lines.en: : Damn it.
lines.zh: : 该死。

lines.en: : Listen, dude. You can talk all the smack you want, but if you think for a second that I am not going to knock you on your ass, you are sorely mistaken.
lines.zh: : 听着,伙计。你随口放狠话随便你,但你要是有一秒钟觉得我不会把你揍趴下,那你就大错特错了。

lines.en: : In that case, is it too late to back out?
lines.zh: : 那样的话,现在退出还来得及吗?

lines.en: scene osakokicksyourass3
: Yup. The least you can do in exchange for taking up a spot on the roster is letting me kick your ass once or twice every few months.
lines.zh: : 来不及。你占了名册上的一个名额,作为交换,你至少该让我每隔几个月揍你一两次。

lines.en: : No worries, I’ll just quit the dojo instead then. Thanks for all of your hard work up until now.
lines.zh: : 不担心,那我干脆退出道场好了。感谢你迄今为止的一切辛勤付出。

lines.en: : You can’t quit. Your story with Ayane hasn’t finished yet.
lines.zh: : 你不能退出。你和 Ayane 的故事还没写完。

lines.en: : Aren’t you guys trying to like, take back Kumon-mi or something?
lines.zh: : 你们不是正在试图,怎么说,夺回 Kumon-mi 什么的吗?

lines.en: : Why do you know about that? And why can I hear the background music for it right now?
lines.zh: : 你怎么会知道那件事?还有为什么我现在能听见它的背景音乐?

lines.en: : You’re not...part of the Amamiya army, are you?
lines.zh: : 你该不是……Amamiya 军团的成员吧?

lines.en: scene osakokicksyourass4
: The what?
lines.zh: : 什么军团?

lines.en: She must be a spy.
lines.zh: 她一定是间谍。

lines.en: Or, even worse...an assassin sent by Ayane to take me down and reclaim the land that her family is owed or...something.
lines.zh: 或者,更糟……是 Ayane 派来除掉我、夺回她家应得土地的刺客,或者……什么的。

lines.en: scene osakokicksyourass5
: Pretend you’re not a part of this all you like. I know that you’re with them.
lines.zh: : 你尽管假装自己与此无关。我知道你是他们一伙的。

lines.en: : Wait, are you actually into that whole roleplaying thing after all?
lines.zh: : 等等,你原来真的喜欢那整套角色扮演?

lines.en: : This whole time I thought you were just playing along to make Ayane happy.
lines.zh: : 我一直以为你只是为了哄 Ayane 开心才配合演的。

lines.en: : That’s precisely what I wanted you to think.
lines.zh: : 那正是我想要你以为的。

lines.en: scene osakokicksyourass6
: Because that means you’ve let your guard down!
lines.zh: : 因为这意味着,你已经放松了警惕!

lines.en: scene osakokicksyourass4
: Do you...
lines.zh: : 你是……

lines.en: : Do you expect me to also become a part of this now?
lines.zh: : 你指望我现在也成为其中一员吗?

lines.en: scene osakokicksyourass1
: I expect you...
lines.zh: : 我对你的期望……

lines.en: scene osakokicksyourass6
: To die!
lines.zh: : 是死!

lines.en: scene black
I gather every last bit of energy in my body and charge at Osako with an ultimate attack.
lines.zh: 我聚起体内最后一丝能量,以一记终极攻击冲向 Osako。

lines.en: One that’s sure to-
lines.zh: 一记必定——

lines.en: : Wait...impossible!
lines.zh: : 等等……不可能!

lines.en: scene osakokicksyourass7
: You know, I was going to say something like “Try and hit me if you can,” but you just went right ahead and attacked me without even getting the signal.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗,我本来打算说点类似「有本事就来打我啊」的话,可你连信号都没接到,就直接冲上来攻击我了。

lines.en: : You’re pretty ballsy for a complete wuss, huh?
lines.zh: : 对一个彻头彻尾的怂包来说,你挺有种的,啊?

lines.en: : Let go of my hand.
lines.zh: : 放开我的手。

lines.en: : And then what? Let you attack me?
lines.zh: : 然后呢?放任你来攻击我?

lines.en: : You interrupted my strongest move.
lines.zh: : 你打断了我最强的招式。

lines.en: scene osakokicksyourass8
: If this is your strongest attack, you really should start paying a little more attention to my lessons.
lines.zh: : 如果这就是你最强的攻击,你真该开始多留心一点我的课了。

lines.en: : There’s a lot I can teach you if you actually open up your mind, you know.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗,只要真心敞开心态,我能教你的还有很多。

lines.en: : For example, do you want to know how I was able to predict the exact motion of your fist before it even reached its halfway point?
lines.zh: : 比如说,你想知道我是怎么在你的拳头刚出、还没到半路时,就预判出它精确轨迹的吗?

lines.en: : Is it because I’m a complete novice?
lines.zh: : 是因为我是彻头彻尾的新手吗?

lines.en: : That’s definitely part of it!
lines.zh: : 那绝对是其中一部分!

lines.en: : In fact, for the sake of today’s exercise, we can even say that’s all of it.
lines.zh: : 实际上,为了今天的教学,我们甚至可以说那就是全部原因。

lines.en: : While competitive karate does exist and is pretty fucking awesome, it doesn’t take away from the fact that it’s still an art of self defense at its core.
lines.zh: : 竞技空手道确实存在,而且他妈的相当帅,但这改变不了一个事实:它的内核终究是一门自卫的艺术。

lines.en: : If someone attacks you on the street, it’s probably safe to assume that they aren’t a trained fighter who knows how to counter things like this.
lines.zh: : 如果有人在街上攻击你,大体可以安全假定:那不是一个懂得如何反击这类招式的受训拳手。

lines.en: : So as long as you’re able to predict their actions before they make them, you have the upper hand.
lines.zh: : 所以只要你能抢在他们行动之前预判其动作,你就占了上风。

lines.en: : Cool. Can I have my hand back now? I want to try hitting you again.
lines.zh: : 酷。现在能把手还我了吗?我想试着再打你一次。

lines.en: : No. Because now it’s my turn to hit you.
lines.zh: : 不。因为现在轮到我打你了。

lines.en: : But since I’m so nice, I’ll let you know how I’m going to attack and where so you can try and block it.
lines.zh: : 但既然我人这么好,我会告诉你要怎么攻击、攻击哪里,好让你试着格挡。

lines.en: : As if I’d fall for that. You’ll just attack whatever place you tell me not to protect.
lines.zh: : 好像我会上当似的。你只会攻击你没让我防的地方。

lines.en: : I know your games, assassin.
lines.zh: : 我看穿你的把戏了,刺客。

lines.en: : No, no. Really. I mean it.
lines.zh: : 不,不。真的。我是认真的。

lines.en: : I’m going to push back on your fist and then attack you from above with a kick.
lines.zh: : 我会顶回你的拳头,然后从上方用踢击攻击你。

lines.en: : What? But how are you going to attack me from above when-
lines.zh: : 什么?可你到底要怎么从我上方攻击,我都还——

lines.en: scene osakokicksyourass9
: HA!
: Wait, what?
lines.zh: : 等等,什么?

lines.en: scene osakokicksyourass10
Osako connects with the side of my neck and I can instantly feel my body beginning to go limp.
lines.zh: Osako 击中了我的颈侧,我瞬间感觉到身体开始瘫软。

lines.en: : Was that...
lines.zh: : 那是……

lines.en: scene osakokicksyourass11
: One of seven ways I know how to kill you in one blow.
lines.zh: : 我所知的七种一击毙命方式之一。

lines.en: : Tell me how the ground tastes, would you?
lines.zh: : 告诉我地面尝起来什么味道,如何?

lines.en: scene black
I hit the ground without even getting a chance to reach out and break my fall with my hands.
lines.zh: 我摔在地上,连伸手缓冲的机会都没捞到。

lines.en: My body is no longer capable of moving.
lines.zh: 我的身体已经无法动弹。

lines.en: I really am going to die today, aren’t I?
lines.zh: 我今天真的要死了,对吧?

lines.en: scene osakokicksyourass12
: Ngh...
: Even though you told me...exactly where I’d be attacked...I couldn’t do anything about it...
lines.zh: : 就算你告诉了我……确切的攻击位置……我也什么都没能做……

lines.en: scene osakokicksyourass13
: Couldn’t? Or didn’t?
lines.zh: : 做不到?还是没做?

lines.en: : Because it seemed like you were too busy admiring how flexible I am to block where I told you to block.
lines.zh: : 因为看起来,你光顾着赞叹我的柔韧性,没去挡我让你挡的地方。

lines.en: : So many...possible positions...
lines.zh: : 这么多……可能的姿势……

lines.en: scene osakokicksyourass14
: Hah...really, man. All you need to do is just listen to me and you can actually become better at this.
lines.zh: : 哈……真拿你没办法,伙计。你只要听我的,就真的能在这方面变强。

lines.en: : I’m trying to actually help you out with your technique right now, and I can’t do that if you’re down there on the floor.
lines.zh: : 我现在可是想认真帮你改进技术,而你躺在下面地板上,我可没法帮。

lines.en: : It doesn’t look like you’re helping me.
lines.zh: : 看起来你并没有在帮我。

lines.en: : I told you what to do and you didn’t do it. Don’t go blaming me for your inadequacy or disinterest.
lines.zh: : 我告诉了你该做什么,而你没做。别把你自己的无能或不上心赖到我头上。

lines.en: : Now get back up and fight me like a real man or I’ll have to show you where your other six pressure points are.
lines.zh: : 现在给我站起来,像个真正的男人那样和我打,不然我就只好给你演示另外六个要害在哪了。

lines.en: : I...don’t think I can move my body.
lines.zh: : 我……觉得我的身体动不了。

lines.en: scene osakokicksyourass13
: Sure you can. I didn’t kick you that hard.
lines.zh: : 你当然能。我没踢那么重。

lines.en: : No...I really-
lines.zh: : 不……我真的——

lines.en: scene osakokicksyourass15
: Ngh-
: Blah blah blah. I’m a weak little bitch who can’t even take one kick from a girl.
lines.zh: : 啦啦啦啦。我是个弱小的小贱人,连一个女孩的一脚都扛不住。

lines.en: : Just...put me out of my misery already...
lines.zh: : 直接……帮我解脱了吧……

lines.en: : Are you Wakana now?
lines.zh: : 你现在是 Wakana 吗?

lines.en: : If I say yes...can we make out?...
lines.zh: : 如果我说是……我们能亲热吗?……

lines.en: scene osakokicksyourass16
: Ngh!
: You think I’d ever kiss someone as weak as you?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我会去亲像你这么弱的人吗?

lines.en: : There is no way...Wakana is stronger than I am...
lines.zh: : 不会吧……连 Wakana 都比我强了……

lines.en: : True. But Wakana is a beautiful woman and you’re just some perverted lowlife.
lines.zh: : 确实。但 Wakana 是个美丽的女人,而你只是个变态的社会渣滓。

lines.en: : Why is your...foot stronger than my entire body?
lines.zh: : 为什么你的……一只脚比我整个身体还强?

lines.en: : Hm?
: Oh. I used to kickbox before starting karate, so I’ve always considered anything involving legwork my speciality.
lines.zh: : 哦。开始练空手道之前,我练过自由搏击,所以我一直把一切涉及腿脚的东西当作我的专长。

lines.en: : How else would I have been able to sink my heel into one of your pressure points without even trying?
lines.zh: : 不然我怎么可能不费吹灰之力,就把脚跟扎进你的某个要害?

lines.en: : Can I...have my head back now?...
lines.zh: : 现在……能把头还给我吗?……

lines.en: : That depends. Are you going to try and kiss me?
lines.zh: : 那得看情况。你还会试着亲我吗?

lines.en: : Not if it means experiencing this level of pain again.
lines.zh: : 如果代价是再体验一次这种程度的疼痛,那不会。

lines.en: : Then sure.
lines.zh: : 那当然可以。

lines.en: : I’ll even go get you a drink as a personal thank you for actually making an effort today.
lines.zh: : 我甚至可以去给你拿瓶喝的,作为对你今天确实努力过的私人谢礼。

lines.en: : Even if that effort was entirely worthless.
lines.zh: : 哪怕那份努力毫无价值。

lines.en: : You are...much scarier than I thought you were...
lines.zh: : 你……比我想象的可怕多了……

lines.en: scene black
Osako removes her foot from my head and I can slowly but surely feel the world begin to solidify beneath me.
lines.zh: Osako 把脚从我头上移开,我缓慢但切实地感觉到,身下的世界开始重新凝固。

lines.en: My legs, which had been as gelatinous as the soup I made with Wakana nights before, stop wobbling and, before long, I’m able to get them to stand upright again.
lines.zh: 我的双腿——那之前软得像几夜前和 Wakana 一起煮的那锅汤——不再打晃,没过多久,便能让它们重新直立。

lines.en: I take another minute or so to fully regain consciousness and manage to open my eyes once I see Osako coming my way with a bottle of water.
lines.zh: 我又花了一分钟左右才完全恢复意识,等看到 Osako 拿着一瓶水朝我走来,才终于睁开了眼。

lines.en: scene osakokicksyourass17
: Uhh...why did you flinch? I’m just bringing you a drink.
lines.zh: : 呃……你缩什么?我只是给你拿瓶喝的。

lines.en: : I think it was a reflex.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那是条件反射。

lines.en: : This might just be how I have to act around you from now on.
lines.zh: : 从今往后,我在你身边也许就得这样行事了。

lines.en: : Oh, stop. I used that same kick on Ayane and she got up in like fifteen seconds.
lines.zh: : 哦,少来。同一记踢我用在了 Ayane 身上,她大概十五秒就站起来了。

lines.en: Yes but she also cried the first time I put my penis inside of her, so I know deep down that I’m stronger.
lines.zh: 是啊,但我第一次把 penis 放进她体内时,她也哭了,所以在内心深处,我知道我更强。

lines.en: scene black
I take the bottle of water from Osako and quickly rehydrate myself.
lines.zh: 我从 Osako 手里接过那瓶水,迅速补充水分。

lines.en: Not because I want to continue training, but because if I don’t, I’ll likely pass out and be stomped on once more.
lines.zh: 不是因为我想继续训练,而是因为不喝的话,我多半会昏过去,然后再被踩上一遍。

lines.en: And while there are plenty of people out there who I am sure would love such a thing...I am very much not one of them.
lines.zh: 而尽管外面那种乐于此事的人想必一抓一大把……我非常、非常不在其中。

lines.en: Osako follows me to the side of the room and leans up against the wall beside me, sparing my life for at least another several minutes.
lines.zh: Osako 跟着我走到房间一侧,靠在我旁边的墙上,至少又饶了我几分钟的命。

lines.en: Or at least that’s what I would think...
lines.zh: 或者说,至少我是这么想的……

lines.en: If she wasn’t an Amamiya family assassin.
lines.zh: 如果她不是 Amamiya 家的刺客的话。

lines.en: scene osakokicksyourass18
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么?

lines.en: scene osakokicksyourass19
: Hah...
: Nothing.
lines.zh: : 没什么。

lines.en: : I can see now why Touka’s family wanted to hire you personally.
lines.zh: : 我现在明白,为什么 Touka 家想亲自雇你了。

lines.en: : That’s not something you could possibly know after like, one tenth of a sparring match.
lines.zh: : 那种事,一场对练才打了十分之一,你不可能知道。

lines.en: : If I was actually trying, you really would be dead right now.
lines.zh: : 如果我真的出了全力,你现在真的已经死了。

lines.en: : Like, that’s not even a joke.
lines.zh: : 就是说,这甚至连玩笑都不算。

lines.en: scene osakokicksyourass20
: Why subject yourself to this then?
lines.zh: : 那你为什么要让自己受这份罪?

lines.en: : Everyone here has little to no experience at all. Don’t you ever get bored having to teach people that are so...below you?
lines.zh: : 这里每个人几乎毫无经验。教这种……远低于你水准的人,你就不觉得无聊吗?

lines.en: : Don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你不吗?

lines.en: : Wakana says you’re pretty smart.
lines.zh: : Wakana 说你相当聪明。

lines.en: : You even recognized that Lord Byron poem I memorized for her when I confessed.
lines.zh: : 我表白时为她背的那首 Lord Byron 的诗,你甚至认出来了。

lines.en: : First off, Wakana specifically made a point of how recognizing things like that doesn’t make you smart.
lines.zh: : 首先,Wakana 特意强调过,认得出那种东西并不代表你聪明。

lines.en: : And secondly, that is adorable.
lines.zh: : 其次,那太可爱了。

lines.en: scene osakokicksyourass21
: Isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 是吧?

lines.en: : A lot of people are surprised to hear that I’m actually into a lot of gothic stuff as well and that I’m not just dating Wakana because of that whole “opposites attract” thing.
lines.zh: : 很多人听说我其实也喜欢一大堆哥特风的东西、我并不是因为「互补相吸」那套才和 Wakana 交往的,都会很惊讶。

lines.en: : Like yeah, that applies to our personalities and styles, but we share a ton of the same interests and-
lines.zh: : 没错,那部分适用于我们的性格和风格,但我们有一大堆共同的兴趣,而且——

lines.en: scene osakokicksyourass22
: And now I’m going to start ranting about her again because I love her so much.
lines.zh: : 而现在我又要开始喋喋不休地念叨她了,因为我实在太爱她。

lines.en: : You never answered the question.
lines.zh: : 你一直没回答问题。

lines.en: scene osakokicksyourass23
: Was there a question? I zoned out when we started talking about Wakana.
lines.zh: : 有问题吗?一开始聊 Wakana 我就走神了。

lines.en: : I asked you why you bothered teaching here since you’re so much better than everyone.
lines.zh: : 我问你,既然你比所有人都强这么多,何必费心在这里教书。

lines.en: scene osakokicksyourass24
: Ahh, right. Right.
lines.zh: : 啊,对。对。

lines.en: : I don’t know, really.
lines.zh: : 说真的,我也不知道。

lines.en: : There aren’t enough advanced martial artists in Kumon-mi for me to make a living off of instructing them, so I guess I just followed where the money was.
lines.zh: : Kumon-mi 的高阶武者不够多,我没办法靠教他们谋生,所以我猜我只是跟着钱走了。

lines.en: : It’s not like this was my first choice or anything. I had much bigger plans.
lines.zh: : 这并不是我的首选什么的。我有过大得多的计划。

lines.en: : Just...can’t really do anything about them anymore.
lines.zh: : 只是……如今已经无能为力了。

lines.en: : What kind of plans are you talking about?
lines.zh: : 你说的是什么样的计划?

lines.en: scene osakokicksyourass25
: Competitions...getting better myself instead of helping others get better.
lines.zh: : 比赛……让自己变强,而不是帮别人变强。

lines.en: : Always wanted to try doing something on a national level because I’m definitely good enough.
lines.zh: : 一直想试试国家级层面的赛事,因为我绝对够格。

lines.en: : But now that no one’s allowed to leave Kumon-mi, that path just...isn’t possible anymore.
lines.zh: : 但如今没人被允许离开 Kumon-mi,那条路就……再也无法走了。

lines.en: : And it doesn’t seem like it’s going to be opening back up anytime soon, so...
lines.zh: : 而且它看起来短期内也不会重新开放,所以……

lines.en: scene osakokicksyourass26
: So I’ll very likely be a little too old to compete whenever it does.
lines.zh: : 所以等它真开放时,我多半已经老到不能参赛了。

lines.en: : Even if it’s a few years, I doubt it would matter-
lines.zh: : 哪怕只是几年,我也怀疑那会不会有影响——

lines.en: : It matters.
lines.zh: : 有影响。

lines.en: : The most important resource for pretty much all athletes is our age.
lines.zh: : 对几乎所有运动员而言,最重要的资源就是我们的年龄。

lines.en: : Every year counts. And when your “prime” is limited to such a small window of your life, everything you do winds up getting centered around that.
lines.zh: : 每一年都作数。而当你的人生「巅峰期」被限制在这么小的一扇窗里,你所做的一切,最终都会围绕它展开。

lines.en: : Then, once it’s gone, it’s all downhill and you’ve just gotta...figure out other shit to do.
lines.zh: : 然后,一旦它逝去,便一路下坡,你只能……去琢磨点别的破事干。

lines.en: : So even if it is only a few years, each one of those years will matter.
lines.zh: : 所以,哪怕只剩几年,那几年里的每一年都会作数。

lines.en: scene osakokicksyourass27
: Or would matter...since chances are that’s not happening and that I’ll be stuck teaching beginners until I can’t move my body anymore.
lines.zh: : 或者说,本该作数……毕竟那种事多半不会发生,而我会困在教新手这份工作上,直到身体动不了为止。

lines.en: I wonder if it’s okay to provide someone false hope even when you know things aren’t going to work out for them?
lines.zh: 我在想,即使明知事情不会有好结果,给人一点虚假的希望,是否也算可以?

lines.en: Obviously, Osako has no idea that time is being reset every few months and that she’ll likely remain in the same limbo her significant other is caught up in-
lines.zh: 显然,Osako 不知道时间每隔几个月就会被重置,也不知道她很可能将和她伴侣一样,滞留在同一种中间态里——

lines.en: But I wonder if it’s okay to pretend that’s not the case.
lines.zh: 但我在想,假装事实并非如此,是否也算可以。

lines.en: To throw a few scripted words of false sincerity at her in hopes that she’s naive enough to eat them up.
lines.zh: 向她抛出几句照本宣科的虚假真诚,指望她天真到照单全收。

lines.en: I guess it’s worth a shot, right?
lines.zh: 我猜值得一试,对吧?

lines.en: : I wouldn’t give up just yet.
lines.zh: : 我暂时还不会放弃。

lines.en: : For all we know, the city could open back up tomorrow and you could board the first flight to...wherever they do karate stuff.
lines.zh: : 谁知道呢,这座城市说不定明天就重新开放,你就能登上第一班飞往……随便哪个有空手道玩意的地方的航班。

lines.en: scene osakokicksyourass28
: Yeah...
: Maybe that will happen.
lines.zh: : 也许那会发生。

lines.en: : Or maybe it won’t.
lines.zh: : 也许不会。

lines.en: : I shouldn’t dwell on it either way.
lines.zh: : 无论哪种,我都不该沉溺于此。

lines.en: : If things do make a turn for the better, that’s definitely the path I’ll wind up walking.
lines.zh: : 如果事情真的好转,那必然是我终将踏上的路。

lines.en: : But for now...I’m happy just walking beside my girlfriend and supporting her.
lines.zh: : 但就现在而言……只要走在女友身旁、支持着她,我就很幸福。

lines.en: : Are you about to start talking about Wakana again?
lines.zh: : 你是不是又要开始念叨 Wakana 了?

lines.en: : God, she’s so fucking cute. I can’t stand it.
lines.zh: : 天,她真是他妈的可爱。我受不了了。

lines.en: scene black
It’s rather unfortunate that I’ll never get to see Osako kicking someone to death on live television.
lines.zh: 相当不幸,我将永远无缘目睹 Osako 在电视直播中把人踢死。

lines.en: But it is fortunate that I’ll get to spend more time with her.
lines.zh: 但幸运的是,我将能和她共度更多时光。

lines.en: An unlimited amount of it, too.
lines.zh: 而且是无限的时光。

lines.en: Who would have thought that someone who’s been this close to me ever since I arrived in Kumon-mi would suddenly become an actual character in my story?
lines.zh: 谁能想到,一个自我抵达 Kumon-mi 起就一直离我这么近的人,会突然成为我故事里一个真正的角色?

lines.en: And I in hers.
lines.zh: 而我,也在她的故事里。

lines.en: We all have our own dreams...goals...desires...
lines.zh: 我们都有自己的梦……目标……欲望……

lines.en: And most of them will float forever, unfulfilled.
lines.zh: 而它们中的大多数,将永远悬浮,无以偿愿。

lines.en: But some of us are fortunate enough to learn this beforehand.
lines.zh: 但我们中有一些人,足够幸运,能提前明白这一点。

lines.en: To create new goals that we can accomplish within shorter amounts of time.
lines.zh: 去创造一些能在更短时间内达成的新目标。

lines.en: And use that manipulation of the laws of the universe to survive or grow.
lines.zh: 并利用这种对宇宙法则的操弄,活下去,或者成长。

lines.en: Then, sooner or later-
lines.zh: 然后,或早或晚——

lines.en: We’ll have everything we’ve ever wanted.
lines.zh: 我们将得到我们想要过的一切。

lines.en: The fortunate ones, I mean.
lines.zh: 我是说,那些幸运的人。

lines.en: Everyone else?
lines.zh: 其他人呢?

lines.en: Well-
Maybe they’ll be rewritten into someone with a little better luck?
lines.zh: 也许他们会被改写成某个运气稍好一点的人?
